title: Iori and the Beast
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a world where half-beasts live alongside humans but rarely love across species, social worker Iori is introducing orphaned wolf boy Riku to wolf writer Tsuneaki Gora (Renta! blurb via AniList and MangaUpdates). Iori, kind but afraid of love, is drawn to Tsuneaki, and the three form a family. MangaUpdates lists adoption, discrimination, LGBT parents and a wedding.
life_message: Family is made by choosing to care for one another, across differences (to verify).

content.note: Adult same-sex romance; MangaDex 'safe'; Yaoi genre and sex-friend category on MangaUpdates (to verify).
Grief of an orphaned child; Iori's fear of love (blurb).
